notes: a third audit pass: sub-agent requests are billed to the chat that started them instead of vanishing from the ring, the cost and the usage table; a tool call cancelled by Stop no longer renders as a green success; desktop notifications actually ask for permission, so the "assistant has a question" and "permission needed" alerts work at all; awaiting a save now means it is saved; deleted chats release their lifted permissions and the deleted-id list is bounded; the workspace content cache stops reaching its ceiling early by miscounting itself; a lazily connected MCP server refreshes the tool list; fs_list and the code index agree on which directories are noise; fs_find accepts a single file as its scope; git_status says when it stopped early; skill_write no longer reports a skills/*.md path that does not exist; and the docs now describe what plugin tools actually ask, rather than what web_fetch asks
